spanish: Porque si rehúsante tú de enviar, y todavía tú aferrado a ellos,
grammarChanges: Changed the preposition after 'aferrado' from 'en' to 'a' (aferrado a ellos) so the hiphil active participle reads as the 2ms subject doing the holding, not as the one being held.
readerNote: Chose 'aferrado a ellos' over 'aferrado en ellos' to keep the active sense (subject holds them), matching the standard Spanish construction aferrarse a algo.
